description: React component for rendering and managing guest permissions tree in Mattermost admin console, including permission toggles, modals, and license-based permission adjustments.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Defines default permissions for guest role, including license-based permission addition.

methods.name: openPostTimeLimitModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to set post time limit.

methods.name: closePostTimeLimitModal
methods.description: Closes the post time limit modal.

methods.name: toggleGroup
methods.description: Handles toggling of permission groups, respecting read-only state.
